tori: I opened a tiny PR that harmonizes the Dedicated provisioning examples and clarifies autoscale edge cases. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4210

sam: dropping by to review terraform and SDK snippets. prefer `redwood.capacity/isolation` annotation.

leo: quick checklist request: add a 3-step migration snippet for reserved->dedicated and a short note about metric stabilization (48h).

tori: added checklist and note. kept it brief. step 2 recommends cordon before draining.

anya: SDK call changed last month; update python sample to `client.capacity.create_dedicated(...)`. also fix the SLA number to 99.95%.

tori: updated both. terraform example now uses the new annotation and autoscale policy `balanced`.

leo: please add an FAQ line about min_replicas interactions with soft preemption. customers hit this.

tori: added FAQ entry and used product term "preempt". linked to internal explainer.

ci-bot: docs build queued for PR #4210

ci-bot: docs build passed — preview: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/pr-4210/

sam: LGTM aside from two style nits. can merge with placeholder diagram; follow up PR for PNG from design.

anya: +1. I'll open the follow-up PR for image once design exports it.

leo: +1. remember to update changelog so PMs can mention migration guidance.

tori: changelog entry added. merging in ~24h if no objections. thanks all!
